title: Red Hat Security Advisory: kernel security update
description: A security update for the Linux kernel in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 addresses multiple vulnerabilities including use-after-free bugs, improper pointer refreshes in IPv6 extension headers, privilege escalation, and input validation issues. The update fixes several CVEs such as CVE-2026-63922, CVE-2026-63924, CVE-2026-64109, CVE-2026-72083, CVE-2026-74283, and CVE-2026-93787. The kernel is a critical component of the operating system, and these fixes improve overall system security. Red Hat recommends applying the update and rebooting the system to ensure protection.
